summary: Telecom Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) disclosing that Director Diego Miguel Bianchi, whose appointment was proposed by FGS Anses (the Argentine pension fund), submitted a resignation for personal reasons, received October 30, 2026. The filing is a routine notification to the Argentine Securities Commission (CNV) under Article 3, Chapter I, Title XII of its rules; the board will consider the resignation at its next meeting. No terms, advisors, or recommendations are stated. No forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure; governance housekeeping only, with no deal or risk-arb angle.
